actions.action: Preserve original highlights independently of current locations
actions.mechanism: Immutable source records keep notes recoverable even when later revisions delete or replace their passages.
actions.implementation: Store original text, revision ID, range, and surrounding context; retain the source revision. Store subsequent attachment decisions separately.
actions.check: Delete a highlighted passage, reload, and verify its original text, revision, context, and note remain accessible and unchanged.
actions.risk: Retained revisions increase storage and require explicit retention policies.

actions.action: Track unchanged passages across section moves
actions.mechanism: Move-aware matching uses exact text and structural evidence rather than offsets or similarity alone.
actions.implementation: Compare revision blocks; require an unambiguous unchanged mapping supported by section identity or surrounding anchors. Record evidence; leave competing matches unresolved.
actions.check: Move a paragraph and verify traceable attachment. Duplicate an identical sentence in indistinguishable contexts and verify neither candidate is automatically selected.
actions.risk: Missing structural evidence can leave legitimate moves unresolved.

actions.action: Keep changed and missing passages visibly unresolved
actions.mechanism: Explicit states and side-by-side comparison prevent suggested passages from becoming silent note attachments.
actions.implementation: Show ambiguous, changed, or missing status beside the preserved original. Offer highlighted differences, candidate locations, explicit confirmation, and “keep original only.”
actions.check: Change “must” to “must not”; require confirmation before attachment. Delete a passage and verify its note remains readable without a replacement.
actions.risk: Excessive candidate suggestions can burden readers and encourage careless confirmation.

actions.action: Scope attachment corrections to explicit revisions
actions.mechanism: Revision-specific decisions prevent one manual correction from silently changing attachments elsewhere in document history.
actions.implementation: Key decisions by highlight and target revision. Default corrections to that revision; require fresh validation for descendants and preserve superseded decisions.
actions.check: Correct an attachment in revision two; verify revision one stays unchanged and revision three receives no attachment without recorded validation.
actions.risk: Additional decision history complicates synchronization and concurrent correction handling.
